title: Replace the eviction loop in TtlCache with a single retain call
description: `TtlCache::evict_expired` walked the entry vector with a manual index and called `Vec::remove` for each entry it dropped, which is quadratic and repeats the index bookkeeping already present in `put`. The author's stated intent was to express the same eviction in one `retain` call so that both mutating paths in the file use the same idiom.
